verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web search/extraction API/service that is itself exposed as an MCP server for AI agents and clients (e.g., Cursor, Claude Desktop) to consume — it is not itself an agent or host application that would plug in and consume other MCP servers' tools. The evidence consistently shows Tavily as the tool-provider side of MCP, not a client that integrates external MCP servers, so this axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
